title: Vector Playground Onboarding: Compact Pipeline Storyboards & Annotated Result Cards
creator: Liam Ortega
description: Create a compact, reusable visual kit for the Embeddings + Rerank onboarding flow that works in docs, the Console quickstart, and the Vector Playground. Deliverables: a set of pipeline storyboards that explain the end-to-end flow, mobile-safe screenshots for the Console onboarding card, annotated result cards showing rerank scores and reasoning snippets, and export-ready assets for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Three pipeline storyboard variants (one single-column mobile, one two-column doc, one fullscreen slide) exported as SVG and PNG
Four annotated sample result cards demonstrating: base embedding similarity, rerank score, short rationale text, and token cost badge
Mobile and desktop screenshot presets with copy approved by PM and localized-ready text placeholders
Figma file organized with named components, tokens, and an export README for engineers
All visual contrast meets WCAG AA and color tokens match Redwood brand variables
tasks: PM review of messaging and sample outputs (due 2026-03-03)
Create annotated result card templates with placeholder copy and score badges
Handoff Figma tokens and export README to engineering
Produce PNG/SVG exports and upload to doc assets bucket
Finalize screenshots and add localized text placeholders
decisions: Use compact vertical storyboards for in-doc quickstarts to conserve space
Rerank sample outputs will show three variants: raw embedding rank, rerank with score, and rerank with brief rationale
Badges: use small circular score pill with numeric 0-100 and color tiers (green/yellow/red) for immediate scanning
Avoid showing model internals or KVs in onboarding visuals to keep content non-sensitive
Export primary assets as SVG for docs and PNG for Console screenshots to preserve fidelity
